status: Frozen before inspecting conservative CHI replay outputs; earlier unguarded CHI aggregate results were previously visible.
rule: Per-city nearest-rank 99th percentile of positive training sensor-minus-official error, rounded up to 0.5F.
training_availability: Fit no later than D-2 of first eligible test date; no test-date selection or outcomes used to tune.
common_settings: Choose b and fee using forecast-only training PnL on eligible available dates; same setting for all three.
main_comparisons: conservative minus current: mean PnL and worst-5-percent mean PnL
uncertainty: 1000 paired day resamples and 7-calendar-day moving-block resamples, preserving missing-date masks.
tail_statistic: Mean of ceil(0.05*n) lowest PnL observations; larger/less negative is better.
no_selection: Retain and report CHI result even if margin is zero, uncertain, or worse; do not change quantile, coverage, or fees after results.
